name: A second standing slot is refused when the schedule is full

statusDetails.message: Request: with apartment 12 holding only Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 and apartments 3, 5 and 7 holding the other three weekly slots, POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 9","weekday":"Friday","startTime":"17:00"}. Observed: HTTP 409 {"ok":false,"reason":"schedule_full","message":"The weekly schedule has no free standing slot. No slot is available to book.","householdSlots":1}. The message does not name a day or time to choose and alternative is absent. Re-read: apartment 12 still holds exactly Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8. Consequence: the second slot is refused because the schedule has no free standing slot, and the original hold remains the only one.
